card.name: Handling, rinsing and disposal instructions
card.fires_on: Words inside practical handling instructions, such as rinsing, flushing, disposing of product, or avoiding contact with body fluids or application sites. It often falls on a small word like 'the', 'of' or 'with' right after a verb such as Dispose, Encourage or avoid contact.

modes.label: Rinse and dispose verbs
modes.description: The word ends or follows a handling verb like Rinse or Dispose.
modes.example: Dispose<< of>> unused product in a safe manner in compliance

modes.label: Body fluid and contact precautions
modes.description: Small words in instructions about contact with urine, fluids or application sites.
modes.example: Children should avoid contact<< with>> unwashed or unclothed application sites

modes.label: Flushing or removal of fluid
modes.description: Words in text about removing or flushing fluids or voiding after a dose.
modes.example: Encourage<< the>> patient to void one-half hour after administration

card.writes: It leans toward odd word pieces and away from words like crossing and pauses, so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It marks small words in instructions on rinsing, flushing, disposing of product and avoiding contact with body fluids.
